description: Canada: prepare the GST/HST return (GST34) for a period: 'GST return', 'HST return', 'GST report', 'what do I owe CRA', 'my Q3 GST'. Returns every line (101 to 113C), the balance owing or refund, the due date and any warnings. Defaults to the last completed reporting period. Always use this tool for a Canadian GST/HST figure; never add up a return yourself. AccountsOS prepares the return, it does not file it with CRA.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

end.description: Last day of the reporting period, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the last completed period.

start.description: First day of the reporting period, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the last completed period.

name: get_gst_hst_return
title: Get Gst Hst Return
